cards.title: Is AICA for you? Probably.
cards.body: AICA is being built for the people who keep Indian families' medicines on track, at home, at the counter and in the clinic.

cards.title: The child managing Mummy and Papa
cards.body: You're juggling work and your parents' BP and sugar tablets from your phone. Family profiles and dose reminders are built for you.

cards.title: Parents who want to stay independent
cards.body: Clear reminders, including 1-0-1 and half tablets, so they can manage their own medicines with a little backup from family.

cards.title: The neighbourhood chemist
cards.body: AI help reading handwriting, and refill predictions that bring regular patients back to your counter. Founding pharmacies use it free during the pilot.

cards.title: Clinics that want calmer consults
cards.body: A patient summary before the visit, so the doctor starts with context. Founding clinics use AICA free during the pilot.

cards.title: Anyone tired of lost prescriptions
cards.body: If your health papers live in a drawer and a WhatsApp group, AICA's shared prescription thread is meant to bring them together.

cards.title: Starting in Lucknow
cards.body: Pilots begin in Lucknow. See the interactive prototype and join the waitlist at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: AICA is for family carers, independent parents, chemists and clinics who want one clear prescription thread.
share: Look after your parents' medicines? AICA is being built for you. aicaglobal.in
